official.h: IT'S GOLD! AFTER 11 YEARS: NEWS OF THE WORLD SOUTHERN 'BRIGHTON'

photos.c: The Brighton in PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Pat Newell takes the baton from Bill Kerr to set off on Stage 10 with a 2 minutes lead. TOP RIGHT: Laurie O'Hara gives Gerry North the lead we all hoped for---46 secs over Portsmouth after 7 stages. John Davies, behind, takes a time-check. CENTRE LEFT: That long stretch of empty road behind Gerry North lengthens with every stride. CENTRE RIGHT:Bill Kerr clocks fastest time on Stage 9---the longest at 6 miles-52 yards. BOTTOM LEFT: The picture Eddie Lacey has waited 22 'Brightons' for---Belgrave crossing the line 3mins-10secs ahead of Portsmouth. BOTTOM RIGHT:Alan Black hands the presentation baton to the Mayor of Brighton Councillor S.D. Deason J.P. Photos by E.D.L. & R.L.
